Aaron’s account, in wording open to revision

Personal account · working draft

When an idea takes up all our attention, we can lose sight of the people living with its consequences. Who is carrying a cost? What have I stopped noticing?

Care might mean listening, offering protection, setting a boundary, or changing an explanation. You can stay with the question without having to produce a lesson or an answer.

Read the fuller explanation

Who is carrying the cost? What have I stopped noticing?

Care can mean attention, protection, a boundary, or the willingness to revise an explanation. These are questions I am still carrying.
